第95章 贤惠的柔雪-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

上一章

娘的，偷情啊！！

李青山躲在黑暗处，听到两个人的声音后便立刻反应过来，这是一对野鸳鸯，而且两个还都是有家室的。

这男的，想必是女的领导。

玩的可开放啊！

“扑通！”

就在李青山感觉没啥意思，准备离开的时候，突然听到一声落水的声音，紧接着便是男人高声呼救道：“救命啊，快来救人啊，有没有人啊……我不会水，我不会水啊……！”

“救我，救我……！”

掉到水中的女人，也扑通着大声呼救道。

“扑通！”

李青山从黑暗中钻出，迅速跳入女人落水的位置。

这女人明显是不会水的，身子已经沉到水下，好在李青山的运气不错，很快抓到了女人，将其硬生生拖上了岸。

不过，这个时候的女人已经昏迷了过去。

“哎呀，这……这不会死了吧，咋办，咋办啊……！”中年男人望着躺在地上的女人，脸上满是慌张道。

李青山双手叠压在一起，用力按了按女人的胸口，一口黄水很快喷了出来，紧接着便是女人一阵剧烈的咳嗽声，眼神中还是难以掩饰的慌张和惊恐。

“救过来了……吓死我了……！”

中年男人长长呼出一口气，抓住李青山的双手道：“小伙子，谢谢你，真是太谢谢你了，你叫什么名字，哪个村的？”

“问这个干嘛？”李青山皱眉道。

“哎呀，小伙子，你救了小兰的命，我当然要好好感谢你！”中年男人此刻还有些惊魂未定道。

“小同志，刚刚谢谢你了！”

“我是咱们县城广播站的，我叫宋兰！”

宋兰朝着李青山伸出手道。

Damn it, cheating!!

Li Qingshan hid in the darkness and immediately realized after hearing the voices of the two people. They were a pair of wild mandarin ducks, and both of them had families.

This man must be the leader of the woman.

It’s so open to play!

"Plop!"

Just when Li Qingshan felt that there was no point in it and was about to leave, he suddenly heard the sound of falling into the water, and then a man shouted for help: "Help, come and save people, is there anyone... I don't know how to swim, I don't know how to swim...!"

"Save me, save me...!"

The woman who fell into the water also splashed and shouted for help.

"Plop!"

Li Qingshan emerged from the darkness and quickly jumped into the position where the woman fell into the water.

This woman obviously didn't know how to swim, and her body had already sunk under the water. Fortunately, Li Qingshan was lucky and quickly caught the woman and dragged her to the shore.

However, the woman at this time had already passed out.

"Oh, this... this is not dead, what should I do, what should I do...!" The middle-aged man looked at the woman lying on the ground, his face full of panic.

Li Qingshan folded his hands together and pressed the woman's chest hard. A mouthful of yellow water quickly spurted out, followed by a violent cough from the woman. There was still panic and panic in his eyes that could not be concealed.

"He was saved...I was scared to death...!"

The middle-aged man took a long breath, grabbed Li Qingshan's hands and said: "Young man, thank you, thank you so much. What's your name, and which village are you from?"

"Why do you ask this?" Li Qingshan frowned.

"Oh, young man, you saved Xiaolan's life, of course I want to thank you!" the middle-aged man said, still a little shocked at this moment.

"Little comrade, thank you just now!"

"I'm from our county radio station, my name is Song Lan!"
